6                              THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY                                  [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)]
                                                            [फा. सं. RW/JAI/RJ/CE-RO/NH-12012/2025/01/3A]
                             MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
                                                    NOTIFICATION
                                               New Delhi, the 29th July, 2025
         S.O. 3505(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building
Gangapur Bypass (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation
of NH23 in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 19 in the district of KARAULI in the state of RAJASTHAN, hereby
declares its intention to acquire such land.

[भाग II—खण्ड 3(ii)]                               भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण                                           7
          Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of
section 3C of the said Act.
